★Request
Display Mejiro Bright
Outfit specified: Casual Clothes

Ehehe. Embarrassing as it is, had I not run into you, Trainer,
one of these pair tickets would have gone completely to waste~.

Walking down the street on a day off with no particular destination in mind,
I spotted a familiar figure.

You look somewhat more exhausted than usual.
Whatever could be the reason~?

Trainer, Trainer! Look over there.
That attraction has only a fifteen-minute wait, they say~!

Trainer, are you all right?
My, your eyes are spinning around and around~.

Yes~... Ah, that is right.
Trainer, if you happen to be free—

With that, in a rare turn of events, Mejiro Bright
took the initiative to guide me through the theme park.

Everyone looks like they are having such a lovely time.
Every nook and cranny is simply bursting with excitement, after all~.
Oh my~, it is dropping~.
Would you care to join me at the amusement park~?

Fufu... There are people boarding that scream machine from earlier~.
And just beyond that, the parade is about to set off.

Escorting someone... is quite difficult after all, isn't it~?
Even deciding to ride the Ferris wheel was your idea, Trainer.

Yes, he is the owner of a theme park.
So I am quite accustomed to places like this, you see~?

Little did I realize at the time,
why this attraction alone had such a remarkably short wait—

...Fufu. Even if we make a little blunder...
when the two of us are together, everything works out somehow.
Still... thanks to you, I had such a woooonderful time too!
(Clunk...!)
If we apologize together, I am sure it will be perfectly all right~.

Enjoying an amusement park with snappy efficiency...
is rather tricky, isn't it~? Now then, next is—

Trainer,
let us go see another attraction~.

If we ride it, that will be the end of our day today.
Would you truly be all right with that~?

Hmm, I thought that if I acted like a speedy, efficient girl,
you might enjoy yourself even more, Trainer.
Mejiro Bright... paid attention to the time and changed our plans?!

It is a pity, but let us pass on this one as well~.
A two-hour wait means it is twice as long as the previous one, after all~.

Now then, shall we head back?
It has gotten quite late, but since we are together, everything will be fine.

Yes, indeed.
Naturally, I also...

And so...
My my, isn't this a wonderful opportunity?
Is that... so~?

I tell her there's no need to rush, and that just strolling through the park
chatting with her is plenty fun enough. Hearing this—

When I give a nod, she seems about to say something more—
but stops herself mid-sentence and joins the line for the Ferris wheel.

Ehehe. Today, I shall give you
a thooorough escort~♪
Here it comes~... Here it comes, you know~...

—This one in particular had reviews like "wrecks your inner ear" and "I legitimately passed out,"
becoming an attraction people actively avoided out of sheer terror.

By that, do you mean... Ah~, the Ferris wheel.
However, the wait time is an hour and a half, you know?

It is so... very beautiful, isn't it~?
From atop the Ferris wheel, you can see allll of the amusement park.
(ROOOAAAR!!)
(Rumble... clatter... rumble... clatter...)

The ride we boarded was called "The Great Spin: Ferocious Descent into Hell."
While scream machines are usually quite popular—

Oh? My, hello Trainer.
Good day to you, what a lovely coincidence~.

My, this attraction... has a one-hour wait.
Hmm, isn't that a wee bit too long?

Trainer.
Thank you very much for today~.

That was utterly terrifying...
I couldn't help but sit down on a bench to recover.

Though we did get a tiny scolding from the dorm leader afterward...
we were able to enjoy a wonderful day off together!

There were plenty of attractions we could ride if we simply queued,
but Mejiro Bright hopped from one spot to the next as if purposefully avoiding them.

Even though Father was kind enough to give me a pair of tickets,
I had completely forgotten about the expiration date~...

My, this one is three hours... When you actually pay attention,
amusement park wait times are quite long, aren't they~?

The sun has already set completely, hasn't it~?
Ah, but do look. The amusement park lights are turning on—

My, this one has a 120-minute wait...
A 120-minute wait means a two-hour wait, doesn't it~?
